description: Requires techjobs.vn sign-in. How the signed-in user's job search is going, from their own Apply Tracker (not market benchmarks): funnel and conversion, days per stage, response and interview rates by source and CV, where each application ended, stalled entries, overdue next steps, outcome reasons, repeated lessons and saved snapshots. For the entries themselves use list_applications; to keep today's numbers use save_insights_snapshot.
name: get_application_insights
title: My application funnel and lessons
